'''''Hi Nanna''''' (transl. Hi Father) is a 2023 Indian [[Telugu cinema|Telugu]]-language [[romantic drama film]] directed by Shouryuv, in his directoral debut, and produced by Vyra Entertainments. The film stars [[Nani (actor)|Nani]] and [[Mrunal Thakur]] in lead roles alongside Kiara Khanna, [[Jayaram]] and [[Priyadarshi Pulikonda]]. The music is composed by [[Hesham Abdul Wahab]].

The plot follows six-year-old Mahi, a girl battling [[cystic fibrosis]], who lives with her loving father, Viraj. Her quest to learn about her absent mother leads to a chance encounter with Yashna, a woman unknowingly connected to her past, unraveling a heartfelt story of lost memories, love, and destiny.

''Hi Nanna was'' released on 7 December 2023, where it received highly positive reviews from audience and critics.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Dundoo |first=Sangeetha Devi |date=7 December 2023 |title='Hi Nanna' movie review: A reaffirming story of love that conquers everything |url=https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/hi-nanna-telugu-movie-review-a-reaffirming-story-of-love-that-conquers-everything/article67613784.ece |access-date=20 January 2024 |work=The Hindu  |issn=0971-751X}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Srikar |first=Ram Venkat |date=7 December 2023 |title=Hi Nanna Review: Heartfelt Treatment Overpowers Predictable Narrative |url=https://www.filmcompanion.in/reviews/telugu-review/hi-nanna-review-heartfelt-treatment-overpowers-predictable-narrative-nani-mrunal-thakur-shouryuv-kiara-khanna |access-date=20 January 2024 |website=filmcompanion.in }}</ref> The film was applauded for its direction, screenplay, cast performances, and music. It became a superhit at the box office.<ref>{{Cite web |date=17 February 2024 |title=Hi Nanna Total WW Collections!! - T2BLive |url=https://t2blive.com/hi-nanna-total-ww-collections/ |access-date=2 September 2025 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Hi Nanna OTT release date– Here's when and where to watch the Nani, Mrunal Thakur starrer |url=https://www.ottplay.com/news/hi-nanna-on-ott-the-expected-release-date-of-the-nani-starrer-is-here/24ceb8cd76948 |access-date=2 September 2025 |website=OTTPlay }}</ref>

== Plot ==
Six-year-old Mahi lives in [[Mumbai]] with her father Viraj, a successful [[Fashion photography|fashion photographer]], her grandfather, and their pet dog, Pluto. Mahi has [[cystic fibrosis]], a fatal [[genetic disorders|genetic condition]], and Viraj dedicates his life to her demanding medical care. Whenever Mahi inquires about her absent mother, Viraj avoids the topic. Upset by his evasion, Mahi runs away from home with Pluto. A woman named Yashna rescues them from a potential traffic accident. At Mahi's pleading, Yashna invites Viraj to a restaurant, where she and Mahi convince him to tell the story of Mahi's mother, Varsha. To make the story easier for herself, Mahi imagines Yashna as Varsha as Viraj narrates the story. 

A young Viraj meets Varsha in [[Coonoor]]. Disillusioned by her parents' bitter divorce, Varsha is initially closed off to love, but she eventually overcomes her fears and marries Viraj despite her mother's fierce objections. Though they initially struggle financially, they are happy. As Viraj's photography career takes off, he expresses a desire for a child. A hesitant Varsha eventually agrees, but their joy turns to profound sorrow when Mahi is born with a chronic illness. Devastated, Varsha suffers a breakdown, blames Viraj for the situation, and openly regrets their marriage. Hearing this, an upset Mahi asks her father to stop the story. Privately, a visibly emotional Yashna urges Viraj to finish. Viraj then reveals that shortly after Varsha's breakdown, the couple met with a severe car accident, leading Yashna to assume Varsha died in the crash.

In a plot twist, it is revealed that Yashna is actually Varsha. She survived the car crash but developed [[retrograde amnesia]], completely forgetting her past, her marriage, and her child. Her manipulative mother lied to Viraj, claiming Yashna wanted a divorce and hated him, while forcing Viraj to stay away under the pretense that any reminders of his family would further traumatize her daughter. Crushed but deeply loving, Viraj chose to raise Mahi alone. Pluto's earlier recognition of Yashna was what initially led to their chance reunion. To shield Yashna from the trauma of her forgotten past, Viraj altered key details during his restaurant narration, such as changing Yashna's sister into a brother. Meanwhile, Yashna is currently engaged to Dr. Aravind, the neurosurgeon who treated her after the accident.

Hoping to avoid further emotional complications, Viraj abruptly takes Mahi and Pluto to [[Goa]]. However, Mahi secretly invites Yashna, and the three reconnect. Yashna finds herself instinctively drawn to Viraj and Mahi, eventually falling in love with Viraj all over again. On Yashna's wedding day to Aravind, Mahi learns the truth about Yashna from the latter's mother, who warns her to stay away from her. 

Doubting the narrative that Viraj's wife would willingly walk away from her family, Yashna abandons her wedding ceremony. She rushes to the hospital where Mahi, having suffered a sudden health crisis, is fighting for her life. Later, Mahi's grandfather, who is actually Yashna's estranged father confronts his wife, pointing out that Viraj raised Mahi selflessly and asserting that Viraj and Yashna belong together. Supported by Aravind and his medical team, the doctors prepare Mahi for emergency lung surgery. Before the operation, Yashna promises Mahi that she will stay by her side to teach her a song. As she bonds with Viraj, Yashna wishes that she had been the one to meet him in Coonoor and become Mahi's mother, completely contrasting the regret she expressed before her amnesia. A flash-forward reveals a grown-up, healthy Mahi singing onstage the very song taught to her by Yashna, confirming the surgery's success and symbolising the permanent reunion of the family.

=== Filming ===
[[Principal photography]] began in February 2023, with the first schedule in [[Hyderabad]]. The second schedule commenced in [[Mumbai]].<ref name=":2" /> The schedule was concluded by 31 May.<ref>{{Cite news |date=31 May 2023 |title=Mrunal Thakur wraps Mumbai schedule of 'Nani 30', says "heart full of gratitude" |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movies/news/mrunal-thakur-wraps-mumbai-schedule-of-nani-30-says-heart-full-of-gratitude/articleshow/100650077.cms?from=mdr |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230604064537/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movies/news/mrunal-thakur-wraps-mumbai-schedule-of-nani-30-says-heart-full-of-gratitude/articleshow/100650077.cms?from=mdr |archive-date=4 June 2023 |access-date=23 October 2023 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> The third schedule was filmed in [[Ramoji Film City]]. Thakur wrapped up her portions for the schedule by 27 July.<ref>{{Cite news |date=27 July 2023 |title=Mrunal Thakur wraps up another schedule of upcoming film 'Hi Nanna' with Natural star Nani |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movies/news/mrunal-thakur-wraps-up-another-schedule-of-upcoming-film-hi-nanna-with-natural-star-nani/articleshow/102159939.cms?from=mdr |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230728001921/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movies/news/mrunal-thakur-wraps-up-another-schedule-of-upcoming-film-hi-nanna-with-natural-star-nani/articleshow/102159939.cms?from=mdr |archive-date=28 July 2023 |access-date=23 October 2023 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> The fourth schedule commenced on 2 September in [[Coonoor]]. The schedule reportedly featured a song sequence.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2 September 2023 |title=Hi Nanna: New shooting schedule of Nani and Mrunal Thakur starrer commences in scenic Coonoor |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movies/news/hi-nanna-new-shooting-schedule-of-nani-and-mrunal-thakur-starrer-commences-in-scenic-coonoor/articleshow/103308905.cms?from=mdr |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231024111212/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movies/news/hi-nanna-new-shooting-schedule-of-nani-and-mrunal-thakur-starrer-commences-in-scenic-coonoor/articleshow/103308905.cms?from=mdr |archive-date=24 October 2023 |access-date=23 October 2023 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref>

== Music ==
{{Main|Hi Nanna (soundtrack)}}
The music and background score is composed by [[Hesham Abdul Wahab]] in his maiden collaboration with Shouryuv and Nani.<ref name=":1" /> The audio rights were acquired by [[T-Series (company)|T-Series]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Trailer Of Mrunal Thakur-starrer Telugu Film Hi Nanna To Release On This Date |url=https://www.news18.com/movies/trailer-of-mrunal-thakur-starrer-telugu-film-hi-nanna-to-release-on-this-date-8672275.html |access-date=2 September 2025 |website=News18 }}</ref> The tracks "Samayama",<ref>{{Cite web |date=8 September 2023 |title=Samayama: First Single From Nani's Hi Nanna Out |url=https://www.filmcompanion.in/news/samayama-first-single-from-nanis-hi-nanna-out |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230920062604/https://www.filmcompanion.in/news/samayama-first-single-from-nanis-hi-nanna-out |archive-date=20 September 2023 |access-date=18 December 2023 |website=Film Companion South }}</ref> "Gaaju Bomma",<ref>{{Cite web |last=Features |first=C. E. |date=6 October 2023 |title='Gaaju Bomma' song from Hi Nanna out |url=https://www.cinemaexpress.com/telugu/news/2023/Oct/06/gaaju-bomma-song-from-hi-nanna-out-48344.html |access-date=2 September 2025 |website=Cinema Express }}</ref> "Ammadi", "Odiyamma," and "Idhe Idhe" were released as singles before the full 10-song album on 18 December 2023. Wahab re-recorded the film's background score using [[artificial intelligence]] thereby becoming possibly the first Indian film to do so.<ref>{{Cite news |date=10 September 2024 |title=Seismic, disruptive: AI's impact on the music industry |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/bollywood/news/seismic-disruptive-ais-impact-on-the-music-industry/articleshow/113223490.cms |access-date=2 September 2025 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> The BGM "Silent Conversations" is based on Raga [[Reethigowla]], and became a huge hit too.

== Release ==
=== Theatrical ===
''Hi Nanna'' had a worldwide theatrical release on 7 December 2023, along with dubbed versions in [[Tamil language|Tamil]], [[Malayalam]], [[Kannada]] and [[Hindi]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=15 October 2023 |title='Hi Nanna' teaser: Nani, Mrunal Thakur star in a feel-good film on love and fatherhood |url=https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/hi-nanna-teaser-nani-mrunal-thakur-star-in-a-feel-good-film-on-love-and-fatherhood/article67423607.ece |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231023015355/https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/hi-nanna-teaser-nani-mrunal-thakur-star-in-a-feel-good-film-on-love-and-fatherhood/article67423607.ece |archive-date=23 October 2023 |access-date=23 October 2023 |work=The Hindu  |issn=0971-751X}}</ref> The film was initially scheduled to release on 21 December 2023, but was later moved to 7 December 2023 in order to avoid clash with ''[[Salaar: Part 1 – Ceasefire|Salaar]]'' and ''[[Dunki (film)|Dunki]]''.<ref>{{Cite news |date=13 October 2023 |title=Nani and Mrunal Thakur's 'Hi Nanna' teaser release date revealed |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movies/news/nani-and-mrunal-thakurs-hi-nanna-teaser-release-date-revealed/articleshow/104377634.cms?from=mdr |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231012171635/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movies/news/nani-and-mrunal-thakurs-hi-nanna-teaser-release-date-revealed/articleshow/104377634.cms?from=mdr |archive-date=12 October 2023 |access-date=23 October 2023 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref>

=== Home media ===
The digital streaming and satellite rights of the film were sold for {{INRConvert|37|c}} to [[Netflix]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=8 December 2023 |title='Hi Nanna' box office collection day 1: Nani and Mrunal Thakur starrer makes a good opening |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movies/box-office/hi-nanna-box-office-collection-day-1-nani-and-mrunal-thakur-starrer-makes-a-good-opening/articleshow/105830742.cms |access-date=25 February 2024 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> The film was made available on Netflix in January 2024 in [[Telugu language|Telugu]], along with dubbed versions of Tamil, Hindi (Hi Papa), Kannada and Malayalam.<ref name="Mrunal Thakur, Nani's 'Hi Nanna' to be out on OTT on this date">{{Cite news |date=30 December 2023 |title=Mrunal Thakur, Nani's 'Hi Nanna' to be out on OTT on this date |url=https://www.zeebiz.com/trending/entertainment/news-mrunal-thakur-nanis-hi-nanna-to-be-out-on-ott-on-this-date-270460 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240104122908/https://www.zeebiz.com/trending/entertainment/news-mrunal-thakur-nanis-hi-nanna-to-be-out-on-ott-on-this-date-270460 |archive-date=4 January 2024 |access-date=4 January 2024}}</ref> It released along with the movie [[Extra Ordinary Man]].

== Reception ==
=== Critical response ===
''Hi Nanna'' received highly positive reviews from critics. The film was applauded for its direction, screenplay, cast performances, and music. {{Rotten Tomatoes prose|score=100|count=7|average=6.7|ref=yes}}

[[Deccan Herald]] gave the film 4/5 stars describing it as "an endearing tale of love and resilience", while also praising its cinematography, music and fresh take on storytelling.<ref>{{cite web |date=9 December 2023 |title='Hi Nanna' review: Endearing tale of love and resilience |url=https://www.deccanherald.com/entertainment/endearing-tale-of-love-and-resilience-2803666 |access-date=25 August 2025 |website=Deccan Herald}}</ref> Paul Nicodemus of ''[[The Times of India]]'' gave it 3.5/5 stars and wrote, "''Hi Nanna is'' a must-watch for those seeking a blend of heart and soul in cinema."<ref>{{Cite news |title=Hi Nanna Movie Review: Heartwarming Tale Of Love And Resilience; Nani, Mrunal, & Kiara Melt Hearts |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movie-reviews/hi-nanna/movie-review/105793018.cms |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240103185607/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/telugu/movie-reviews/hi-nanna/movie-review/105793018.cms?from=mdr |archive-date=3 January 2024 |access-date=7 December 2023 |work=The Times of India}}</ref> Raghu Bandi of ''[[The Indian Express]]'' gave it 3/5 stars and wrote "Nani and Mrunal Thakur star in a high-emotion drama that will remind you of actor's ''[[Jersey (2019 film)|Jersey]]''."<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 December 2023 |title=Hi Nanna movie review: Nani, Mrunal Thakur impress in a poignant tale of love and bonding |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/movie-review/hi-nanna-movie-review-nani-mrunal-thakur-impress-in-a-poignant-tale-of-love-and-bonding-9058145/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231210032123/https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/movie-review/hi-nanna-movie-review-nani-mrunal-thakur-impress-in-a-poignant-tale-of-love-and-bonding-9058145/ |archive-date=10 December 2023 |access-date=7 December 2023 |website=[[The Indian Express]]}}</ref>

Neeshitha Nyayapati of ''[[Hindustan Times]]'' wrote, "Shouryuv’s debut film is an emotional drama that’ll tug at your heart, both with its performances and storyline."<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 December 2023 |title=Hi Nanna review: Nani, Mrunal Thakur, Kiara Khanna shine in this emotional tale |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/telugu-cinema/hi-nanna-review-nani-mrunal-thakur-kiara-khanna-shine-in-this-emotional-tale-101701935694901.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231211115217/https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/telugu-cinema/hi-nanna-review-nani-mrunal-thakur-kiara-khanna-shine-in-this-emotional-tale-101701935694901.html action entertainers."<ref>{{Cite news |last=Dundoo |first=Sangeetha Devi |date=7 December 2023 |title='Hi Nanna' movie review: A reaffirming story of love that conquers everything
